newsitem.title: ITALY: BASKETBALL-STEFANEL MILAN KEEP CHARLEROI IN MISERY.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-STEFANEL MILAN KEEP CHARLEROI IN MISERY.

text.p: Italy's Stefanel Milan tightened their grip on EuroLeague basketball group A when they beat hapless Charleroi of Belgium 73-63 on Thursday.

Pivot Gregor Fucka led all scorers with 21 points and U.S. guard Anthony Bowie added 10 to help the Italians surge to a 38-27 halftime lead over Charleroi, who have yet to win in the EuroLeague from 14 attempts.
Eric Cleymans netted 15 points to help group A's bottom club keep the scoreline respectable.
Stefanel, who beat Olympiakos 73-71 in Milan last month, face the Greeks again next Thursday in a match vital to the Athens' club's hopes for qualifying for the final 16.

Unhappy Charleroi have just two more matches in which to record their first EuroLeague success. Stefanel with 25 points from an 11-3 record will finish top of group A even if they lose their last two games.
